5. **Project Laurens Jansz. Coster** — screened and deferred. The Dutch Royal Library describes it as a copyright-free classic-Dutch-literature online library, but the project is no longer updated and substantially overlaps the already maintained DBNL discovery route.

### Passing integration: Arkiv for Dansk Litteratur

ADL is a joint classic-Danish-literature project of Det Kgl. Bibliotek and Det Danske Sprog- og Litteraturselskab. The current DSL project description covers 78 authors and provides facsimile/searchable text access. Separately, Det Kgl. Bibliotek publishes the dataset **“Arkiv for Dansk Litteratur: tekster uden for ophavsret”**, covering 156 works dated 1851–1945 and explicitly marked **Public Domain Mark 1.0**.

That explicit dataset boundary is not generalized to the entire ADL reading site: modern editorial introductions, particular editions, scans/facsimiles, and other rendered materials can carry separate rights. The live `tekster.kb.dk/adl` reading surface returned HTTP 403 to the current automated verification client, so the integration does not depend on or bypass that route.

WebNR therefore admits a deliberately small **link-only** starter with exactly three reviewed first-party destinations: the DSL project overview, the Royal Danish Library ADL repository collection, and the exact public-domain dataset item. The source stores only those destination URLs plus WebNR-authored labels/descriptions and `Link-only-WebNR-editorial` markers. It does not mirror ADL text, HTML, PDF, scans, images, catalog records, metadata, ZIP archives, TEI/XML, search results, biographies, introductions, or annotations; it introduces no runtime crawl/search/API call, dataset download, archive extraction, TEI parser, cookies, login, credentials, proxy, or background synchronization.

A richer ADL adapter remains gated on an exact endpoint/access/robots/rights/transport/file-identity/update/deletion/pagination/timeout/response-size/encoding/TEI/unknown-node/failure audit plus deterministic versioned fixtures and the project's queued TEI-to-reading-text runtime. Maintained source families increase from **27 to 28**. `Web Novel Discussion Radar Starter` remains unchanged at **12** link-only routes.
